data.Name: Drogon DG1 — Key Uncertainties
data.Description: Key subsurface and development uncertainties identified during the DG1 Identify & Assess evaluation of the Drogon Valysar formation. 4 factors with High/Medium impact ratings.

StringColumn: Porosity varies 0.10–0.28 across facies; Channel-dominant segments (CentralHorst) have higher confidence than Floodplain-rich segments (NorthSea, EastLobe).
OWC modelled at 1710 m TVDSS with ±15 m uncertainty; deeper OWC would increase STOIIP but also water production risk.
Deeper segments show evidence of diagenetic cementation reducing effective porosity and permeability, particularly in Crevasse facies.

Bounding and intra-reservoir faults may act as sealing or partially-sealing barriers, isolating drainage blocks and reducing sweep efficiency. This risk could require additional infill wells beyond the current 12-well plan and extended production testing, with significant cost increase implications (estimated 50–150 MUSD additional CAPEX). Mitigation: production testing to confirm pressure connectivity, and up to 4 additional wells targeting isolated fault compartments.
